newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Ford EPS estimates trimmed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Ford EPS estimates trimmed.

text.p: --Salomon Brothers auto analyst Jack Kirnan said he reduced his earnings estimate for Ford Motor Co for the fourth quarter to $1 per share from $1.10 per share and for the full year 1996 to $3.45 per share from $3.55 per share.

--"We would continue to accumulate Ford on any price weakness and believe the shares' downside is buttressed by both a relatively attractive dividend yield (five percent) and an asset valuation that essentially places a zero value on the company's core auto making unit," Kirnan said.
